Rejected M184071:1.2.4@SSIC2020: Although it measures the correct SSIC 2020 Information & Communications job vacancy stock and covers 2020-Q1 to 2024-Q4, it is quarterly rather than annual, and the annual average-of-quarter-ends series is available for direct annual comparison.

Recompute the annual comparison using the verified employment and vacancy series, explicitly annualising quarterly vacancy observations with a documented method, aligning both series to the same year labels, and then calculate the correlation and draft findings.
Rejected M182841:3.4@SSIC2020: This annual employment-level series is the correct sector and metric, but it starts in 2008 and has no observations for 1985–1990.

Find and validate an appropriate Singapore employment-level dataset or series for the Information & Communications industry covering 1985 to 1990, checking whether older industry classifications or linked historical series are required.
Rejected M182841:3.4@SSIC2020: This annual employment-level series starts in 2008, so it is missing every requested year from 1985 to 1990.

Rejected M184021:1@SSIC2020: This series is all industries rather than SSIC 2020 Information & Communications, so it does not fit the planned sector despite covering the quarterly recruitment-rate metric.
Rejected M184021:1.4.4@SSIC2020: Rows 1.4.4, 2.4.4, 3.4.4, and 4.4.4 all map to Information & Communications by occupational group, so no single unambiguous sector-level series could be selected.

Find and validate the quarterly Information & Communications recruitment-rate series for 2020–2024, and confirm it is comparable with the already selected job-vacancies series in industry classification and frequency.
Rejected M184021:2.4.4@SSIC2020: This row is an Information & Communications recruitment rate for a specific occupational group rather than the all-occupations industry rate required for the plan.
